text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
While out on a shopping trip, Ayumi spots {0},
and finds herself silently following his steps as usual.
text_block_list.orig_text:
買い物に来ていたアユミは{0}を見つけ、
いつもの癖で声もかけずに跡をつけていた。

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
Where could he be going today?
Oh, but he looks as dashing as ever...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}先輩、
どこ行くのかなー。
今日もかっこいいなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: Oh, he's talking to a cat... That's so cute...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
猫に話しかけてる……
かわいい……

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
It's fun to see sides of him I didn't know about like this,
but our date the other day was even more fun... Eheheheh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして{0}先輩の
新しい一面が見られるのもいいけど、
この前のデートは
もっと楽しかったなぁ……
えへへへ……

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
If I just approach him directly again, maybe I'll be able to...
Ohhh, but that's still too embarrassing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
また、
あの時みたいに近づければ、
もしかしたらもっと……
うぅ、
でもやっぱりまだちょっと恥ずかしい！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
N-now he's leaving the city...
What could he be planning to do all the way out here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
街の外まで来ちゃった……
{0}先輩、
ここでなにをするんだろう……

text_block_list.name: Monster 1
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
Wahh?! There's a monster right by him!
...Huh? It's only a little one, though...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃっ！？　
{0}先輩の前に魔物が！
……あれ？　
でも、
かなり小さい……？

text_block_list.name: Monster 1
text_block_list.text: GGRUOOOGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... He defeated it... Did he take on a monster slaying job?
Wow... I'd never have the courage to do that on my own...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
{0}先輩、倒してる……
魔物退治のお仕事かな……
すごいなー……
私だったら
怖くて一人じゃ戦えないよ……

text_block_list.name: Monsters 2 & 3
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
Eep! T-two of them at once?
Oh no... Should I step in and help him? But that's scary...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひっ、
に、
二体も同時に……
どうしよう……
助けに入った方がいいんじゃ……
でも、怖い……

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
H-he's helped me out so many times...
And now he's in trouble...! But I just don't have the courage...
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
今までたくさん助けてもらってたのに……
{0}先輩がピンチなのに……
また、
勇気が出ない……

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: I really am just a useless...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり、
私なんか……

text_block_list.name: Monster 2
text_block_list.text: GGRUOOOGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: O-oh, wow! He defeated one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
す、
すごい！　
一体倒した！

text_block_list.name: Monster 3
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: Ahh! Look out—!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
あぶなっ──

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
S-stand back, please!
How dare you hurt {0}?! Take this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ、
下がってください！
よくも{0}先輩をー！　
えーいっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster 3
text_block_list.text: GGRUOOOGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
Wahhh! Urgh... I-I won't run!
Because...  Because I...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひうっ！　
うぅ……
に、
逃げない！
私が……
私が……！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: This time... It's finally my turn to help him!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度は……
私が{0}先輩を
助けるんだぁぁぁ！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: やああ！！

text_block_list.name: Monster 3
text_block_list.text: GGRUOOOGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: I... I beat it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
た、
倒した……！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: Ahh! Oh, {0}! Are you OK?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
{0}先輩！　
大丈夫ですか！？

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: D-don't thank me! I don't deserve it!You're the one who's always helping me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いえいえ！　
とんでもないです！
いつも助けてもらってますし……

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
{0}...! P-please don't push yourself!
Y-you're not... too badly hurt, I guess...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}先輩！　
む、
無理しないでください！
け、
怪我とかは……
大丈夫そうですね……

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh?
Wh-why am I standing next to {0}...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
あれ？
わ、
私、
なんで{0}先輩のそばに……

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. I saved him...
...Huh? Whaaaaaaaaa?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
そっか
私が助けに……
え、
ええええええ！？

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
I-I leapt out and saved him?!
Th-this is a dream, right?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
私が{0}先輩を、
たすけっ！？
ゆ、
夢じゃなくて！？

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: Buehh?! I-i-it's all real?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぴゃっ！？　
げげげ現実！？

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
P-please stop thanking me! My body just, um...!
When I saw them attacking you, I just moved on total instinct!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
お礼なんてそんな！　
無我夢中で、私！
{0}先輩が攻撃されたの見て、
無意識に体が動いちゃったんです！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
And... really I should have helped you out much sooner,
but I was too scared...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だけど
ホントはもっと早く助けに入っていればよかったのに、
私、
できなくて……！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
Eh...? Ahh... aaahh... Waaaaahhhh!
I-I'm so happy I managed to help yooooou!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
うぐっ……
っ……
うえええええん！
……しぇ、
しぇんぱいのお力になれて、
よかったですぅぅぅ！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: I'm just so happyyyyy! Waaaahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うれじいんでずぅぅぅぅぅ！　
びえー！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: *hic* 'Cause I... 'Cause I... I'm so happyyyyyyy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひっく、
だって……
だって……
うれじいんだもぉぉぉん！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
I-I mean, you've helped me so many times...
I... I always wanted to repay you somehowwww!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
私……
何度も{0}先輩に助けてもらって……
い、
いつかちゃんとお礼がじだいっでおぼってぇぇぇ！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
B-but I'm such a coward,
I never managed to do anything useful! *hic*
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なのに勇気がないから、
いづも空回りばかりじでだんでずぅぅ！　
ひっく！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
A-after all this time, I can't believe I really... aahhh...!
R-really managed to help...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんな私がっ、
{0}先輩を助けることがっ、
ううっ！
で、
できた……
なんて……！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: Waaaaahhhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: うわあぁぁぁんっ！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... I-I'm so sorryyyy!
It's just, I... I really thought I'd never be able to...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっく、
ご、
ごめんなさいぃ！
自分にはっ、
絶対できないって、
思ってたからあぁぁ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
After that, {0} stayed by Ayumi's side for a while
until she managed to regain her composure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その後、アユミが落ち着くまで、{0}は
そっと隣に寄り添うのだった。
